active_wave.verification_scope: All 11 sealed artifact paths were independently fetched at the selection snapshot and each returned Git blob matched ACTIVE_WAVE.

expansion_reason: Six previously unassessed high-relevance exact-manifest members had material marginal evidence: two reservation-aware crash/replay evaluators, two primary-source recovery-class studies, one concrete multi-fault repair/effect witness, and one durable logical-comparison derivation contract. Expansion is not for coverage alone.

assessments.assessment_basis: The sealed evaluation checkpoint and its read-back validation implement a reservation-aware auditor with seven explicit compliance states, reject all 357 nonempty torn-COMMIT prefixes, and report zero optimistic fail-closed violations across 5,000 generated campaigns. The evidence is direct executable worker-local validation of the artifact's intended scientific-authority rule.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: Within the injected contract-faithful atomic/reservation/reporter harness, a planned slot contributes its durable score only after RESERVE, exact attempt binding and COMMIT to the exact SLOT digest; noncompliant planned slots fail closed to score=1 and torn COMMIT prefixes do not enter scientific evidence.
assessments.scope_limits: The exact repository sibling modules were not byte-executed together, multi-process writer fencing is outside scope, and the artifact is not a deployed runtime migration. The 5,000 campaigns are generated tests, not independent reproduction or production incident-rate evidence.

assessments.assessment_basis: The close/replay validation directly exercises fail-closed bypass handling, missing-COMMIT reconciliation, 2,633 nonempty torn-CLOSE cuts, recomputed-payload tamper rejection and mixed legacy/new replay. These tests materially strengthen the crash-safe closure mechanism beyond the standalone auditor.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: In the worker-local contract-faithful harness, a complete compliance CLOSE can persist/rederive the reservation-aware row, keep every tested torn CLOSE from advancing reporting state, reject recomputed-frame tampering, and preserve legacy closed rows while applying the new rule only to compliance CLOSE events.
assessments.scope_limits: The old launch-capability gate/runtime still binds legacy replay and would reject or reconstruct the wrong state after a compliance CLOSE whose row differs from legacy SLOT acceptance. Full repository-local ADMIT→RESERVE→SCORE→SLOT→COMMIT→CLOSE→next-ADMIT byte execution remains unperformed; no multi-process fencing evidence.

assessments.assessment_basis: AgentCheck provides same-suite mitigation interventions and an official released result artifact. The primary paper and official mitigation report agree that retry can move timeout/API-error cells from 3/10 or 5/10 to 10/10 while stale/wrong-data cells can regress, and the all-mitigation bundle can underperform a targeted single mitigation on the same fault family.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: For AgentCheck's tested five-agent MCP fault workbench and mitigation set (retry backoff, schema validation, injection scanning), mitigation effects are fault-class dependent and combining plausible mitigations is not a monotone improvement.
assessments.scope_limits: Cells are small (10 scenarios per fault type), model/workbench specific, and do not include rollback, critic refresh, postcondition verification or irreversible external-effect recovery. Treat as direct class-conditioned/non-additivity evidence, not a universal mitigation ranking or production failure rate.

assessments.assessment_basis: BENCH2ROBUST explicitly constructs retry_works, switch_needed and impossible recovery classes and evaluates interventions across seven models from four families and two multi-turn benchmark families. The primary paper reports 69/70 noisy configurations below clean performance, held-out Retail gains up to +16.8 pp from BTM without retraining, and combined BTM+RL performance around 40.8–45.5% under injection while preserving clean performance in tested conditions.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: In BENCH2ROBUST's controlled stochastic tool-use environments, robust recovery depends on latent solvability class rather than failure detection alone, and structured runtime recovery context plus learned policy changes can materially improve robustness on held-out tested tasks.
assessments.scope_limits: BTM includes hand-structured fallback maps/heuristics and RL changes the policy, so the result does not isolate a generic runtime retry/switch/abstain selector. Benchmarks are controlled environments rather than irreversible real-world systems; combined gains should not be attributed to one component.

assessments.assessment_basis: The sealed multi-agent run replaces categorical witness labels with concrete signed/bound event objects and tests 15 named compound cases plus 100,000 sampled multi-fault omission/replay episodes. Under its scoped attacker it reports 0 unsafe admissions, and 183,535 one-positive-event-loss checks show no case where removing positive evidence makes repair/effect permission more permissive.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: Within the stated deterministic synthetic attacker model where fresh positive signatures/bindings cannot be forged, positively binding history, identity, capture, dependency, authorization and effect evidence can enforce fail-closed repair/effect decisions and distinguish recorded-result replay from provider redispatch.
assessments.scope_limits: This is worker-local synthetic mechanism/conformance evidence, not a proof or deployment study. Truthful issuers are assumed; forged/colluding attestations, compensation, partial multi-provider effects and noisy correction verifiers are outside scope. Counts are not incident probabilities.

assessments.assessment_basis: The sealed self-improvement contract composes three separately observed public mechanisms: GitMoot's candidate-local PACE gate with a non-atomic paired-update seam, CreativeLift's transactionally deduplicated event ingestion plus sequential statistic recomputation from durable evidence, and idempot-js semantic request fingerprint conflicts. The resulting immutable paired-comparison architecture removes the two-authoritative-arm crash state by construction.
assessments.exact_supported_scope: The source-bound observations support an architecture in which one semantically fingerprinted immutable paired-comparison event is authoritative and sequential-test/materialized arm state is deterministically derived, providing a concrete falsification target for crash/retry idempotency.
assessments.scope_limits: No inspected public system implements the full composition end-to-end. Provider-side exactly-once/reconciliation, PACE statistical validity, cross-candidate error spending, full chronology and an untouched outer test remain separate unresolved contracts. This is a design inference, not measured end-to-end improvement.
